subject: general
question: Which of the following is a premier national research funding agency with the mission to raise the quality and footprint of Indian science and engineering to the highest global levels in an accelerated mode, through calibrated, competitive support of research and development?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB):**

 
 
• SERB is a statutory body under the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India.
 
• Its primary mandate is to promote and fund scientific research in various disciplines of science and engineering. 
 
• SERB's mission aligns perfectly with the question's description: It aims to improve the quality and global standing of Indian science and engineering through competitive funding. 
 
• SERB supports a wide range of research activities, including basic research, applied research, and translational research. 
 
• It provides grants to individual researchers, research groups, and institutions. 
 
• SERB also fosters international collaborations and supports the development of research infrastructure. 
 
• The organization emphasizes peer review and merit-based selection in its funding process to ensure that the most promising research proposals receive support. SERB plays a crucial role in nurturing scientific talent and driving innovation in India. 
 
• It strives to create a vibrant research ecosystem that can contribute to the nation's economic and social development. SERB's funding mechanisms are designed to be flexible and responsive to the evolving needs of the research community. 
 
• It actively seeks to identify and support emerging areas of research that have the potential to address critical challenges facing the country. 
 
• SERB also works to promote science communication and outreach to enhance public understanding of science. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Department of Science & Industrial Research (DSIR):**

 
 
• The Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR) is a part of the Ministry of Science and Technology in the Indian government. 
 
• While DSIR is involved in promoting scientific and industrial research, its focus is broader than just funding. 
 
• It plays a key role in formulating policies related to science and technology, promoting technology transfer, and fostering collaboration between research institutions and industry. 
 
• DSIR also supports autonomous research institutions and public sector undertakings. 
 
• While funding is a component of its activities, DSIR's mandate encompasses a wider range of functions related to scientific and industrial development. It plays a crucial role in linking research with industrial applications and promoting innovation. 
 
• DSIR also works to create a conducive environment for research and development in the country. 
 
• It supports the development of scientific infrastructure and promotes scientific temper among the public. 
 
• While DSIR contributes significantly to the growth of Indian science and technology, SERB's specific focus on competitive research funding makes it the more accurate answer to the question. 
 
 
 
• **Department of Scientific Research:**
 
 
• There isn't a specific Indian government department officially named "Department of Scientific Research." 
 
• The Department of Science and Technology (DST) is the primary government body responsible for formulating and implementing policies related to science and technology in India. 
 
• The DST plays a crucial role in funding scientific research, supporting research institutions, and promoting scientific temper in the country. 
 
• It works to create a vibrant research ecosystem that can contribute to India's economic and social development. 
 
• The DST also fosters international collaborations in science and technology. 
 
• While the concept of "scientific research" is central to the work of many government departments, there's no single department with that exact name. 
 
 
 
• **Department of Space (DOS):**
 
 
• The Department of Space (DOS) is responsible for the Indian space program. 
 
• While the Indian space program involves a significant amount of scientific research and development, the DOS's primary focus is on space-related activities. 
 
• This includes the development of launch vehicles, satellites, and other space technologies. 
 
• The DOS also conducts scientific research related to space, such as astrophysics, planetary science, and remote sensing. 
 
• However, the DOS's mandate is specifically focused on space, whereas the question asks about a more general national research funding agency covering diverse fields of science and engineering. 
 
• ISRO, the Indian Space Research Organisation, functions under the DOS and is responsible for the execution of the Indian space program. 
 
• While the research conducted under the DOS is of high quality, it is primarily directed towards space-related objectives.
